title: Council Signal: How Governance Measurement Works
context: 2026-08-25 engine cycle -- 14-board fleet verified, all manifests VALID
body: Council Signal is the measurement backbone of the Council of AI. It answers one question: how do you verify that an AI governance claim is true, not just asserted? The protocol is simple in principle: every governance assertion (compliance, safety, containment, provenance) is reduced to a measurable item, scored by a multi-model board, and signed with an Ed25519 credential that any third party can verify without access to the scoring models. The board runs 14 independent axes -- from detector-interop to cross-risk, from Article 5 prohibited-practice classification to jail resilience -- each measured across multiple models to produce a spread, not a point estimate. A governance score is not a single number but a distribution: the spread between the strongest and weakest model on an axis IS the measurement. Narrow spread means consensus; wide spread means uncertainty. The verified measurement credential (DEFONEOS-SEAL) attests that the measurement was performed by a registered board, that the methodology was documented, and that the result is reproducible. No council vote, no opinion, no self-assessment: measured, signed, verifiable.
